description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing Git fetch operations, particularly in scenarios involving many packs. It sets up repositories, creates refs, populates packs, and measures fetch performance.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Sets up a large number of pack files in a Git repository to simulate large repository scenarios for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, used here to create repositories and refs.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test, measuring the time taken for Git fetch operations in this case.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
